review.reason: The first round has the most natural paper grain and a readable red selvedge. The quiet woven structure stays subordinate to text.
The second round balances a warm material with visible garment contours. Its displaced seam reads as an intentional pattern fragment without crowding the reading area.
The first round preserves the blue chalk outline and ruler marks most clearly. Cooler stock distinguishes it from the two warm options while keeping the same atelier vocabulary.
review.recommendedUse: A cooler Studio or documentation surface.

review.reason: The first round keeps the dark cloth grain, red stitches and pale lower edge visible. Later rounds lose too much of the stitching at thumbnail size.
review.recommendedUse: Showcase or closing section with light text.
